entities.name: Wasil ibn Ata
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wasil ibn Ata (699–748), also known as al-Ghazzal, was a Muslim theologian and jurist. He is considered to be the founder of the Mu'tazilite school of Aqidah and Kalam.
